name: Oat Flour
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO as oats are low FODMAP and provide soluble fiber that may help with digestive regularity without excessive fermentation.
preparationTips: Can be used as 1:1 substitute for wheat flour in many recipes
May need additional liquid in baking as oat flour absorbs more moisture
Store in airtight container to prevent rancidity
Can make at home by grinding rolled oats in food processor
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of protein for a grain
Contains important minerals like manganese and phosphorus
